crossRefs.note: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow…
Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring…
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
“You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
“Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
“ ‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and…
You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the…
Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor…
He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…
To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…
